label: Rule feeds
description: Sources of rules kept in sync by the workflow task "Rule feed — sync" (Admin → Workflows, template "Rule feeds refresh"). One entry per feed: key (letters, digits, _), label, kind (git = a repository, imported like Git Import; url = one rules file over https, e.g. ET Open; valhalla = Nextron's VALHALLA API, key in .env VALHALLA_API_KEY), url, format (forces the rule format when set), license (applied when a rule has none), author, enabled (false: the task refuses to run it), license_ok (true only when the feed's licence allows Rulezet to republish its rules — required for kinds whose rules are not openly licensed, e.g. Valhalla: written consent of Nextron), branch (git), valhalla: product / min_score. Each run adds what is new; rules already in Rulezet are skipped as duplicates. Add a feed here, then add its task to the workflow.
